title: UKM ignored during KARI decryption
description: try_decrypt_kari() extracts ukm from the KARI and passes it to key.agree_ecdh(). However, encrypt() sets ukm: None unconditionally in build_kari_recipient() and ecdh_wrap_cek() also passes entity_u_info: None to EccCmsSharedInfo. This means round-tripping through encrypt/decrypt within this crate works, but if a peer sends a KARI with a non-None UKM, the DecryptionKey implementor receives the UKM correctly. The gap is: the doc for agree_ecdh() says 'hash Z concatenated with a counter and the SharedInfo structure (which encodes alg.key_wrap OID and ukm)' — but the SharedInfo built in ecdh_wrap_cek does NOT include the UKM (entity_u_info: None). Decrypt implementors who follow the trait doc and build SharedInfo from alg will NOT incorporate UKM from the wire, causing silent decryption failure for UKM-bearing messages.
close_reason: UKM IS passed to agree_ecdh via the ukm parameter. Encrypt path intentionally does not generate UKM (ukm: None in build_kari_recipient) per RFC 5753 — UKM is optional.
